spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (तटति)
To be elevated or high, to rise.
r. 10th cl. (ताटयति)
To beat.

mfn. sub. (-टः-टा-टी-टं)
A shore or bank.
n. (-टं)
A field.
E.
तट to rise or be high, affix अच्, fem. aff. ङीप्.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
1 Indifferent, alien, neuter.
2 Situated on the bank or shore.
m. (-स्थः)
An indifferent person, one neither a friend nor a foe.
n. (-स्थं)
That property which is distinct from the nature of any thing, yet is the faculty by which it is known: in other words, spiritual essence unconnected with bodily wants or passions.
E.
तट a bank, a height, and स्थ who stands.

m. (-कः)
A pond deep enough for the lotus and other aquatic flowers.
E.
तट a bank, and अक to go, affix अच्; also तडाक; also ताटाक and तटीक.

f. (-नी)
A river.
E.
तट a bank, and इनि poss. aff.

m. (-ङ्कः)
An ornament of the ear, a large sort of ear-ring: see ताडङ्क and तालपत्र.

n. (-स्थ्यं)
1 Indifference, disregard, exemption from attachment or aversion.
2 Proximity.
E.
तटस्थ, and ष्यञ् aff.
